description: ctrlyoke workflow templates for common automation patterns

workflows.label: Template Starter
workflows.description: Demonstrates every template variable type and its available metadata

workflows.label: Simple Feature Workflow
workflows.description: Plan → Implement → Commit in same session

workflows.label: Parallel Research
workflows.description: Run independent research prompts concurrently, then synthesize their findings

workflows.label: Fix Tests
workflows.description: Fix failing tests with validation retry loop until they pass

workflows.label: Full Feature Pipeline
workflows.description: Fixed pipeline: Plan → Review plan → Implement → Polish → Review → Docs → Commit, with a second harness reviewing and a test gate

workflows.label: Spec-Driven Loop
workflows.description: Orchestrator plans, queues, and reviews the work until a spec/design document is fully implemented

workflows.label: Feature-Driven Loop
workflows.description: Describe a feature and get a plan-first self-extending loop that queues and reviews work until the goal is met

workflows.label: Bug Hunt Loop
workflows.description: Open-ended loop that reviews the last round of fixes, files new bugs in your repo, and queues their fixes

workflows.label: Bug Drain Loop
workflows.description: Loop that queues fixes for the bug reports filed in your repo until the backlog is empty
